review_notes: I read the whole file. I also grepped the project for the supporting definitions (homogeneousCoordinatePoint, projectivizationToProj, affineCoordinatePoint, normalizedCoordinates). Each is defined once in the sibling files HomogeneousCoordinatePoint.lean and HomogeneousCoordinateChart.lean, and this file doesn't redefine them. I grepped Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for closedPoints and JacobsonSpace, and Mathlib for Projectivization together with Proj or ProjectiveSpectrum. I found no existing map or equivalence from Projectivization to Proj, and no existing closed-points description of polynomial Proj. The definitions projectivizationToClosedPoint and projectivizationEquivClosedPoints are specific bridges between Mathlib's Projectivization and closedPoints of Proj. They build on Mathlib's closedPoints, Equiv.ofBijective, and Scheme.Hom.closePoints_subset_preimage_closedPoints. The private Jacobson-space lemma proves a fact that Mathlib doesn't provide for Proj, and it reuses Mathlib's JacobsonSpace API. The file therefore adds no competing version of an existing concept. I did not check whether Mathlib has a more general closed-point equivalence for Proj of a finitely generated graded algebra. I found no sign of one in the searches above.
